purpose: Hash-bound registration inputs retained from measured source-art profiles; changing source path, source crop, PNG bytes, requested whole-image origin, neck/belt measurement or uniform density requires visual registration-overlay review and a reviewed artifact update. These are not gait/joint targets.
initial_provenance: Existing production measured face/neck/belt registration. Independent QA reviewed the motion-region overlays; new candidate measurements must be reviewed before production adoption.
uncertainty: Template registration uncertainty has not been independently calibrated. It is not a claim of subpixel anatomical joint accuracy. Boot/cloth checks include conservative pixel margins; selected toe observations have explicit uncertainty in contract.json.
